BEGINNER
The ability to highlight the unique benefits of the dealership’s aftermarket offerings to effectively promote and sell aftermarket products and services. Able to support the machine sales team throughout the machine sales process.

INTERMEDIATE
Skilled in customizing aftermarket products and service proposals to enhance customer value based on their specific needs. Stay up to date on market trends and work closely with key dealership teams to ensure a smooth customer experience while optimizing revenue opportunities.

EXPERT
Demonstrates deep mastery in aftermarket sales by proactively identifying and capitalizing on complex revenue opportunities. Develops and implements innovative strategies to maximize customer lifetime value, integrating data-driven insights and market trends. Builds strong, consultative relationships with customers to position the dealership as a long-term partner. Leads and mentors’ teams, driving continuous improvement in aftermarket offerings, customer retention, and profitability.

BEGINNER
The ability to utilize knowledge of the dealership’s products and services to log and escalate routine issues. Able to resolve straightforward customer inquiries and refer complex technical problems to the appropriate teams, ensuring smooth support workflows and an efficient customer experience.

INTERMEDIATE
The ability to resolve issues effectively by coordinating with dealership teams and managing technical and non-technical inquiries, acting as a bridge between customers and the dealership to ensure smooth communication and effective issue resolution.

EXPERT
Demonstrates deep mastery in aftermarket support by independently diagnosing and resolving complex technical and service-related challenges. Proactively identifies patterns in customer issues to drive continuous improvement in service offerings and operational efficiency. Develops and refines support strategies, ensuring seamless collaboration across dealership teams to enhance customer satisfaction and retention. Leads and mentors’ teams, fostering a culture of proactive problem-solving and innovation in aftermarket support.

BEGINNER
Able to sell the Crawler Excavators by presenting key features and benefits tailored to the customers’ needs. Conduct effective walkaround demonstrations, emphasizing machine applications and safety protocols. Safely performs basic operations, including starting, moving, and stopping the machine.

INTERMEDIATE
Proficient in selling the Crawler Excavators by tailoring solutions to customer needs. Effectively compares competitor models and highlights advantages with practical examples incorporating total cost of ownership into discussions. Keeps up with market trends to adapt recommendations. Customizes options and suggestions to fit customer goals, building confidence in the purchase decision.

EXPERT
Demonstrates deep mastery in crawler excavator sales by developing and executing strategic approaches that drive long-term customer partnerships and business growth. Expertly analyzes customer operations, financial considerations, and industry trends to provide data-driven recommendations that maximize productivity and profitability. Innovates in sales tactics by integrating machine technology, attachments, and service solutions into a complete value proposition. Acts as a trusted consultant, influencing fleet management decisions and guiding customers through complex investment choices. Mentors and supports colleagues, sharing expertise to elevate overall dealership sales performance.

BEGINNER
Understands the basic layout and functionalities of the PROSIS platform. Can recognize the purpose of PROSIS and navigate through the start page, various catalogs, and service tabs. Capable of locating and following simple instructions within service protocols.

INTERMEDIATE
Proficient in navigating PROSIS, including locating special tools and interpreting repair instructions. Capable of finding main components and detailed diagrams.

EXPERT
Possesses in-depth knowledge of PROSIS, including advanced settings and troubleshooting. Can interpret complex instructions and service protocols, guide advanced problem-solving, and utilize Guided Diagnostic.

BEGINNER
Skilled in performing software updates and proficient at reading error codes.

INTERMEDIATE
Experienced in parameter programming, accessory kit installation, component calibration, and handling.

EXPERT
Recognized authority in TechTool Proficiency, capable of training others and acting as a product specialist. Expertly manages complex diagnostics, leads advanced troubleshooting efforts, and provides comprehensive support and guidance on TechTool usage and optimization.

BEGINNER
Familiar with MATRIS system with knowledge of its usage and application. Capable of basic readouts and server uploads.

INTERMEDIATE
Capable of independently generating comprehensive reports and conducting daily readings with minimal supervision.

EXPERT
Skilled in data analysis and advanced report creation. Highly regarded as a mentor for MATRIS-related tasks, providing valuable guidance to others.

BEGINNER
Possesses a sound understanding of the hazards related to the operation of electrical construction machinery, along with a keen awareness of local laws and regulations governing its use. (Instructed Technician)

INTERMEDIATE
Possesses requisite knowledge and skills to proficiently commission and decommission electrical machines. (Technician Responsible for Work Activity)

EXPERT
Experienced electrical safety expert with comprehensive knowledge of regulations and expertise in handling electric machines. Skilled in identifying and mitigating hazards for construction equipment. Provides coaching and guidance on electromobility safety. (Electromobility safety 
Dealer Trainer)

BEGINNER
Versed in the foundational aspects of parts ordering and claims processes. Can accurately identify parts and manage reman components based on repair orders within the dealership environment.

INTERMEDIATE
Proficient in advanced parts ordering using Volvo CE tools, with a focus on customer education regarding the benefits of genuine parts. Capable of monitoring parts delivery to ensure efficiency and timeliness.

EXPERT
Mastery in parts ordering systems, strategies for service excellence, and claims handling. Provides mentorship on optimizing parts procurement and reman component management, enhancing dealership operations.

BEGINNER
Proficient in essential workplace health and safety practices in office and hands-on environments. Recognizes and reports potential hazards while utilizing crucial personal protective equipment.

INTERMEDIATE
Proficient in health/safety principles, regulations, hazard identification, and PPE use. Complies with procedures, collaborates seamlessly, and responds adeptly to emergencies. Committed to maintaining a safe work environment.

EXPERT
Demonstrates deep mastery of workplace health and safety by integrating and advancing best practices across the organization. Proactively identifies, analyzes, and mitigates complex safety risks, ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and industry standards. Innovates and implements strategic safety initiatives that enhance workplace culture, reduce incidents, and improve operational efficiency. Acts as a trusted advisor and mentor, guiding teams in fostering a proactive safety mindset. Expertly navigates high-stakes situations, leading investigations, developing advanced safety protocols, and driving continuous improvement in health and safety performance.

BEGINNER
Demonstrates appreciation for Volvo CE values and heritage while confidently communicating quality, safety, and environmental care commitments. Maintains a basic understanding of the Volvo CE product portfolio to ensure consistent and value-aligned communication with internal and external stakeholders.

INTERMEDIATE
Able to effectively convey Volvo CE’s technological advancements and competitive strengths. Highlights Volvo’s unique qualities and builds customer trust by clarifying how the brand provides value in the market.

EXPERT
Demonstrates deep mastery of Volvo CE’s brand identity, seamlessly integrating its values, heritage, and technological leadership into every customer and stakeholder interaction. Develops and implements brand-driven strategies that strengthen market positioning and customer loyalty. Expertly articulates Volvo CE’s competitive advantages in complex, high-stakes discussions, influencing decision-makers and industry perceptions. Acts as a brand ambassador, mentoring colleagues and driving initiatives that enhance brand awareness, customer trust, and long-term business success.

BEGINNER
Competent in basic machine maintenance. Familiar with required tools and equipment, follow maintenance procedures including oil changes, filter replacements and inspections. Proficient in basic Wheel Loader operation capable of placing the machine in service position.

INTERMEDIATE
Skilled at diagnosing and fixing complex issues including engine, transmission, hydraulic, and electrical problems. Well-versed in safety protocols for the machine and effective communication on the job site.

EXPERT
Machine expert with extensive knowledge and exceptional troubleshooting skills. Proficient in diagnosing and repairing complex problems independently. Skilled at root cause analysis, effective solutions, repairs, and part replacements. Proactive in preventive maintenance, communication, and prioritizing safety and productivity.

BEGINNER
Understands fundamental principles and possesses basic skills in mechanical systems, diagnostic processes, welding, and maintenance tasks. Capable of using hand tools, power tools, diagnostic equipment, lifting gear, welding apparatus, and has basic knowledge of heavy vehicle mechanics and systems. Demonstrates the ability to perform simple repairs and diagnostics under supervision.

INTERMEDIATE
Skilled technician adept at utilizing Volvo special tools for hydraulic and electric system measurements. Proficient in ensuring accurate measurements and maintaining system integrity. Committed to delivering high-quality work with a focus on safety and precision.

EXPERT
Expert in troubleshooting construction equipment, diagnosing and repairing complex problems independently. Analyzes root causes, develops effective solutions, performs repairs and part replacements. Skilled at proactive problem identification and providing preventive maintenance recommendations. Effective communicator, prioritizing safety and productivity.

BEGINNER
Beginners understand basic electrical concepts, including voltage, current, and resistance, and can differentiate between series and parallel connections. They are familiar with common electrical components and their functions but require guidance for practical tasks. Their practical skills extend to using tools for basic repairs under supervision.

INTERMEDIATE
At the intermediate level, technicians have a solid grasp of electrical theories, can explain key electrical relationships, and understand the functions of common components. They apply correct measurement techniques and have a foundational understanding of wiring diagrams. These technicians can perform basic electrical system repairs with minimal guidance, showing growing independence.

EXPERT
Experts have an in-depth knowledge of electrical systems, including advanced components and detailed wiring diagrams. They are proficient in advanced diagnostics and repairs, capable of troubleshooting complex issues independently. Expert-level work is characterized by autonomy, precision, and adherence to best practices in electrical repair and safety.

BEGINNER
Gains foundational knowledge of hydraulics, including basic physical phenomena and safety. Learns to identify main hydraulic system components and their functions. Begins to understand basic hydraulic diagrams and safety checklists.

INTERMEDIATE
Builds on basics to include identification and differentiation of hydraulic system components and their symbols. Can interpret advanced hydraulic diagrams and understand control functions and system types. Initiates practical application in troubleshooting with a focus on environmental safety and efficiency.

EXPERT
Achieves deep expertise in hydraulic systems, mastering complex diagnostics, advanced system functions, and pressure compensation. Can innovate and optimize hydraulic systems for performance. Guides others in troubleshooting and maintenance, setting safety and efficiency standards.

This skill group includes practical skills in parts identification, ordering, warranty handling, system navigation, customer support, and cross-functional collaboration. The skills ensure accurate, efficient, and customer-focused parts operations, supporting uptime, safety, and dealership performance.
Expert Level: Posses extensive knowledge, skill, experience. Solves complex problems, can coach others.
Beginner Level: Completes simple tasks on own; requires guidance with complex tasks.
Intermediate Level: Performs task to a standard without guidance
